# golki llms.txt

Project: Jira clone (React/Next.js) matching Atlassian design system.

## Where to look
- Agent contract: /AGENTS.md
- Codebase design: /AGENT_FRIENDLY_CODEBASE.md
- UI research: /RESEARCH.md
- Design system: /DESIGN.md
- Data model: /docs/data-model.md (planned)
- Architecture: /docs/architecture.md (planned)

## Stack
Next.js 15, React 19, TS strict, Tailwind v4, HeroUI v3, Prisma+Postgres, Zustand, TanStack Query, Biome, Vitest, agent-browser+Lightpanda, @atlaskit/pragmatic-drag-and-drop.

## Commands
bun install | bun run dev | bun run typecheck | bun run check | bun run test | bun run e2e
